name: Party Type 28 Code
definition: Type of entity involved in a card payment transaction.

ACCP.name: Acceptor
ACCP.definition: Card acceptor, party accepting the card and presenting transaction data to the acquirer.

AGNT.name: Agent
AGNT.definition: Entity providing card payment processing services acting as an intermediary between an acquirer and an issuer.

OTHN.name: Other National
OTHN.definition: Other card payment entity type defined at national level

OTHP.name: Other Private
OTHP.definition: Other card payment entity type defined at private level
